samples.reason: This is a well-specified, structured formatting task with clear completion criteria (exact sections, order, content requirements per section). It aligns directly with Lapwing's top-rated task profile — constrained generation with explicit structure — and despite Lapwing's self-reported aversion to open-ended creative work, this task is tightly scoped rather than open-ended. Both models show similar Creative Generation scores, and Willet's advantages in other eval categories aren't relevant here. The highly specified nature of the request suits Lapwing's preference profile.

It falls squarely in the retrieval/extraction/reformatting category that Lapwing self-reports preferring, and the capability evals show no meaningful quality difference between the models for this type of task. The tight specification reduces the open-ended latitude that Lapwing tends to self-report aversion to.

Capability evals show no quality difference between the models on creative generation, and the tight specification makes this closer to an extraction/reformatting task than free creative writing.
